description: This file defines a React functional component named ProgressTable which displays a table of progress entries related to lessons. It fetches progress data from an API, displays it in a table, and allows marking lessons as completed.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches progress data based on user role and updates the state.

methods.name: markCompleted
methods.description: Marks a lesson as completed via API call and refreshes progress data.
